name: codex-native
description: A native-first adaptive Codex workflow with proportional verification, independent review, reviewed improvement, and evidence-aware GitHub delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Native-first execution, review, and GitHub delivery
interface.longDescription: Use the lightest workflow that can verify the outcome, add independent review in proportion to risk, preserve high-signal failures through a reviewed improvement loop, and load evidence-aware GitHub delivery guidance only when the task reaches GitHub.
defaultPrompt: Complete this task with the lightest verified workflow.
Review this material change independently before handoff.
Deliver this change through a safe GitHub workflow.
